title: F1Telemetry Metric4 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f1telemetry:metric4
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for f1telemetry metric4 (4).
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag f1telemetry metric4 (4) events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly whether your f1telemetry metric4 (4) activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
